newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Elan exercise option, take $141 million charge.
newsitem.headline: Elan exercise option, take $141 million charge.

text.p: Elan Corp., a British-based drug delivery company, said Tuesday it will exercise its option to acquire all of Advanced Therapeutic Systems, Ltd.'s outstanding stock at $36 a share in cash, or $141 million.
Elan will incur a one-time charge of about $141 million in the quarter ending Sept. 30, for the purchase.
Advanced Therapeutic, a Bermuda-based drug research firm formed in May 1993, granted the option two months later to Elan, whose shareholders funded the company's rights offering.
Dublin, Ireland-based Elan said it will exercise the options by the end of October.

"The decision to buy back ATS follows a detailed review of the value of the ATS portfolio and represents a major vote of confidence in the future of Elan as well as giving an excellent return to those Elan shareholders who participated in the ATS offering," said Elan President and CEO Donal Geaney.
Elan's principal research and manufacturing facilities are in Ireland, the United States and Israel.
Elan's stock fell 12.5 cents to $32.125 on the New York Stock Exchange. Advanced Therapeutic was unchanged at $34.25 on the American Stock Exchange.
